description: This file defines a PHP trait named ValidatorTrait within the OrangeHRM project. The trait provides a protected method 'validate' that wraps a call to a static Validator::validate method, enabling validation of input parameters against defined rules. The file includes licensing information and namespace declarations.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: A protected method that validates an array of values against optional parameter rules by calling the external Validator::validate method.
